# Fixtures for `flac` (FLAC)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The audio is a
synthetic sine tone; titles, names and labels (Saltmere Brass Band, Mira Castell, Ana
Lighthouse, Example Records) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/audio.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `bells-ffmpeg.flac` | ffmpeg 7.1 (native FLAC encoder) | CC0-1.0 |
| `bells-reference.flac` | flac 1.5.0 (reference encoder): Vorbis comments, picture, cue sheet; ReplayGain by metaflac | CC0-1.0 |
